messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up: final prep for the marketplace + joint webinar launch next week. Need to lock lead routing, UTMs, and the benchmark one-liner for the listing. Who can claim the HubSpot workflow?

Ajay Kapoor: I9ll own HubSpot. We already have a webhook endpoint `POST /webhooks/hubspot` that creates contacts with `origin=partner-marketplace`. I9ll extend it to set `owner` based on `partner` value.

Tess Gallagher: Thanks Ajay. We'll standardize UTMs: utm_source=partnername, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=partner-launch-q2. Use lowercase and hyphenate multiword partner names.

Sam O'Neill: Routing question: default to SDR queue, but escalate to Partner AE for named-partner prospects? I9d like AE assignment for known partner accounts.

Maria Chen: Agreed. Rule: if `partner=CloudBridge` then owner=AE_CloudBridge and trigger partner share. Otherwise owner=SDR_Marketing. Partner contract says lead-share within 48h.

PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: partner contract requires lead share email within 48h. Docs: https://redwood.company/partner-ops/lead-share (automated)

Ajay Kapoor: Draft webhook payload I9ll test in rehearsal: 
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
{
  "email": "j.smith@example.com",
  "origin": "partner-marketplace",
  "partner": "CloudBridge",
  "utm_source": "cloudbridge",
  "utm_campaign": "partner-launch-q2"
}
```
Workflow will: 1) create contact, 2) set owner by partner, 3) send SLA alert if not touched in 24h, 4) queue partner-share email at 48h.

Tess Gallagher: I9ll update the blog and marketplace listing CTAs to include hidden fields: partner=CloudBridge, utm_campaign=partner-launch-q2, referrer=marketplace_listing. Also will coordinate button text with design.

Sam O'Neill: Please add `first_seen_model` as a hidden registration field so we can segment Dedicated vs Hosted trials. e.g., `first_seen_model=redwood-dedicated`.

Maria Chen: Good call. Tess, please make the benchmark landing page top-line: "x% lower cost, y% lower latency vs baseline" then short FAQ on methodology + hardware. Keep it CLO-focused and snappy.

Tess Gallagher: Will do. I9ll have a draft landing + blog copy by Tuesday EOD and post link here.

Sam O'Neill: Rehearsal slot Wed 10:00am PT. Need attendees for smoke test of forms and owner routing.

Ajay Kapoor: I9ll join Wed 10am PT and run webhook tests live. I9ll include negative cases: partner blank -> default SDR, utm missing -> mark `utm_missing=true`.

Maria Chen: Add a test where partner value is unexpected (e.g., `partner=CloudBridgeX`) to ensure fallback to SDR and to flag partner ops.

Ajay Kapoor: Included.

PartnerOps Bot: Event created: "CloudBridge joint webinar rehearsal" 94 Wed 10:00am PT. Attendees: Maria Chen, Ajay Kapoor, Tess Gallagher, Sam O'Neill.

Tess Gallagher: Rehearsal checklist I9ll paste in the doc: 1) registration populates hidden fields, 2) webhook fires with correct payload, 3) HubSpot contact owner routing correct, 4) partner-share email queued, 5) landing page copy QA + benchmark one-liner.

Maria Chen: After rehearsal I9ll do a smoke test: trigger form, verify contact appears with owner and tags, confirm partner ops email format. Ajay, can you add an automated test that POSTs to webhook and asserts owner field?

Ajay Kapoor: Yep, I9ll add a small integration test in CI for the webhook and a runtime smoke script we can run during rehearsal.

Sam O'Neill: If rehearsal is green we schedule marketplace listing Thurs morning and public blog Fri. Webinar invites go Fri afternoon.

Maria Chen: Sounds good. Tess, drop the doc link here when ready and I9ll mark this thread for follow-up after rehearsal.
